## Source

Survival in patients with advanced lung cancer from the North Central Cancer Treatment Group (NCCTG). Performance scores rate how well the patient can perform usual daily activities.

The data are distributed as the `lung` dataset in the R [survival](https://cran.r-project.org/package=survival) package. The Stata file is an export of that dataset with variable and value labels added, periods in variable names replaced by underscores, and a 0/1 death indicator (`stata_status`) added.

Reference: Loprinzi CL, Laurie JA, Wieand HS, et al. Prospective evaluation of prognostic variables from patient-completed questionnaires. North Central Cancer Treatment Group. *Journal of Clinical Oncology*. 1994;12(3):601-607.

## Dataset

### Stata

Download: [lung.dta](../../data/lung.dta)

or use directly in code

```stata
use https://tphofer.github.io/ncsp-hhcr/data/lung.dta
```

Example do-file (Kaplan-Meier curves, log-rank test, Cox model): [lung_cox.do](../../data/lung_cox.do)

### R

The dataset is included in the survival package

```r
library(survival)
data(cancer, package = "survival")
head(lung)
```

The R version uses the original variable names (`ph.ecog`, `ph.karno`, `pat.karno`, `meal.cal`, `wt.loss`) and does not contain `stata_status`.

## Dataset description

### Features

time to death, right censoring, performance status, 228 patients

### Variables

```
. codebook, compact

Variable      Obs Unique      Mean  Min   Max  Label
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
inst          227     18  11.08811    1    33  Institution code
time          228    186  305.2325    5  1022  Survival time (days)
status        228      2  1.723684    1     2  Censoring status (1=censored, 2=dead)
age           228     42  62.44737   39    82  Age (years)
sex           228      2  1.394737    1     2  Sex
ph_ecog       227      4  .9515419    0     3  ECOG performance score (physician)
ph_karno      227      6  81.93833   50   100  Karnofsky score (physician)
pat_karno     225      8  79.95556   30   100  Karnofsky score (patient)
meal_cal      181     60   928.779   96  2600  Calories consumed at meals
wt_loss       214     53  9.831776  -24    68  Weight loss in last six months (lbs)
stata_status  228      2  .7236842    0     1  Death indicator (0=censored, 1=dead)
-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
```

### Value labels

```
stata_status:
           0 Censored
           1 Dead
ph_ecog:
           0 Asymptomatic
           1 Symptomatic, ambulatory
           2 In bed <50% of day
           3 In bed >50% of day
           4 Bedbound
sex:
           1 Male
           2 Female
status:
           1 Censored
           2 Dead
```

Karnofsky scores range from 0 (dead) to 100 (normal); `ph_karno` is rated by the physician and `pat_karno` by the patient.

### Survival setup in Stata

```stata
stset time, failure(stata_status == 1)
```
